resources.string: Allows Watchpost, in Device Owner mode, to log security and network events and to apply the privacy policy chosen in the app. Everything is reversible from the app.
Disabling the Watchpost administrator stops the device protection. This action is recorded and reported to the server.
In Device Owner mode, prevents "Force stop" and "Clear data" on Watchpost, and exempts Watchpost from app sleeping. Reversible here.

If the enforced DNS server stays unreachable (network not validated and DNS over TLS check failing), Watchpost sets private DNS back to automatic mode to keep Internet. The fallback is reported (severity 2). Disabled: protection comes first, the phone stays without Internet until the server returns or the DNS is cancelled.
Continuous failure duration before switching to automatic mode.
Re-enforce the DNS when the server answers
After a fallback, re-enforces the host as soon as it answers again (checked first).

Android security log (Device Owner): ADB commands and transfers, boots and shutdowns, successful or failed unlocks, keys and certificate authorities, media mounting, restrictions, app installs, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections, process starts. Delivered by the system in batches (at most every 2 h), no periodic polling. Volume: a few hundred entries per hour, mostly process starts (aggregated by default).
Every process start with the fingerprint of its APK (the chattiest tag).
One event per process and per hour, with the number of starts.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections and disconnections seen by the security log.

Android network log (Device Owner): every DNS request (name requested, addresses) and every outgoing TCP connection (address, port), with the app that made it. Delivered in batches (at most 1200 entries or every 1 h 30). Does not see connectionless UDP (QUIC), hard-coded addresses or DNS encrypted by apps. Turns on the system "network monitored" notice. Volume: up to several hundred entries per hour (reduced by aggregation).
The same request (same app, same name or same address and port) repeated within the window becomes a single event with a counter.
Duration over which identical requests are grouped.
Also record connections (address and port), not only DNS.

Security state: patch level, encryption, lock, ADB debugging (USB and wireless), developer options, unknown sources, private DNS, always-on VPN, Device Owner, verified boot, added certificate authorities, USB signal (Play Protect: no reliable reading, omitted). At boot, once a day and on every change (one event per changed field). Also reports the addition or removal of a certificate authority and unlock failures. An unreadable field is omitted.
In addition to the default SMS app and the system apps, always spared. Pre-filled with the default SMS app.
In addition to the default dialer and the system apps, always spared. Pre-filled with the default dialer.
The system ones always remain allowed; a service that is already enabled is kept (Android requires it).
The system ones (Samsung keyboard) always remain allowed; a keyboard that is already enabled is kept (Android requires it).
